title: Live-Action Viral Hit Series Streams 1st 4 Minutes Ahead of Netflix Premiere
content: Netflix has released the first four minutes of its webtoon-based live-action series Viral Hit on YouTube in Japanese, offering an early preview ahead of its global debut on the platform on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: The Forsaken Saintess and Her Foodie Roadtrip in Another World Anime Reveals More Cast, July 6 Debut
content: The staff for the television anime of Yoneori 's The Forsaken Saintess and Her Foodie Roadtrip in Another World ( Suterare Seijo no Isekai Gohan Tabi: Kakure Skill de Camping Car o Shōkan Shimashita ) light novel series revealed on Thursday two additional cast members and July 6 debut.
author: ANN

title: Mebius Dust Anime Reveals 6 Cast Members
content: The official website for Dōga Kōbō 's original television anime Mebius Dust , based on Hajime Shinagawa 's story of the same title, revealed new cast members for the anime on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Cyborg 009: Nemesis Anime Casts Junko Minagawa as Cyborg 001
content: The staff of Ishimori Production 's Cyborg 009: Nemesis , a new anime based on Shōtarō Ishinomori 's Cyborg 009 manga, announced on Thursday that Junko Minagawa will voice Cyborg 001/Ivan Whiskey in the series. Cyborg 001 is the strategist for the 00 Cyborgs despite being an infant.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Hametsu no Oukoku' Concludes Seven-Year Serialization
content: yoruhashi 's Hametsu no Oukoku ( The Kingdoms of Ruin ) manga will conclude its nearly seven-year run with the 15th volume on July 9, according to Mag Garden's listing. yoruhashi began serializing the adventure fantasy manga in Comic Garden magazine in April 2019.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Grand Blue Dreaming Anime Season 3's New Video Reveals Ending Song, July 6 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Kenji Inoue and Kimitake Yoshioka 's Grand Blue Dreaming manga started streaming the anime's third official promotional video on Thursday, which revealed its July 6 debut on Tokyo MX and BS11 at 24:00 JST (effectively July 7 at 12 midnight JST).
author: ANN

title: Kanojo no Tomodachi Anime Reveals Cast, Staff, October TV Premiere
content: The official website for the television anime of Jura 's Kanojo no Tomodachi (My Girlfriend's Friend) manga revealed a new visual, cast members, staff, and the October television premiere date for the anime on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: 'Kanojo no Tomodachi' Announces Production Staff, Main Cast for Fall 2026
content: WWWaveCorporation 's Deregula animation label opened an official website for the television anime adaptation of Jyura 's Kanojo no Tomodachi ( My Girlfriend's Friend ) manga and revealed the production staff, main cast, and the first key visual (pictured) on Thursday. The anime begins to air in October 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Grand Blue Season 3 Main Trailer Previews Theme Song and July 6 Premiere
content: Grand Blue Season 3 anime revealed the main trailer featuring both opening and ending theme songs, along with a July 6 premiere date. The season will be set in Palau, meaning it will travel overseas for the first time. Shinji Takamatsu is back to direct at studios ZERO-G and Liber.
author: Anime Corner

title: Netflix’s One Piece Live-Action Returns With a Surprise New Release Ahead of Season 3
content: It’s been a few months since Netflix’s One Piece live-action Season 2 was released, but the hype around the series hasn’t died down at all. After making fans wait for more than two years, the second season follows the Straw Hat Pirates’ journey into the Grand Line, where they meet new allies and enemies.
author: ComicBook
